summary: Frontend mobile preview loaded and dashboard baseline rendered. Core add flow was blocked because the record modal save button is outside the 390x844 viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844 mobile viewport, the form sheet content extends below the viewport and record-save-button is outside the viewport, preventing users from saving or validating a record reliably.

issues: Form is not scrollable and has no max-height/safe-area handling; lower controls are clipped on mobile.

action_items: Wrap the modal sheet contents in a keyboard-aware ScrollView or constrain sheet height with scrolling so amount, validation, and Save controls remain reachable at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: RecordForm lacks scroll handling despite multiple option rows plus date, amount, and buttons; this causes the observed clipping.
Interactive tab options and settings clear action lack dedicated testID attributes, reducing automated accessibility coverage.
Delete confirmation actions are native Alert buttons and do not expose the specified delete-confirm-button testID.
seed_data_creation: The attempted flow did not create records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the public preview URL with 390x844. Dashboard and summary testIDs load. Add-income-button opens a sheet, but record-save-button is outside viewport before any amount is entered.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open add income at 390x844, locate record-amount-input, then attempt record-save-button. Playwright reports Element is outside viewport. Root cause: modal sheet is a plain View with fixed content and no internal ScrollView/max-height; the combined form height exceeds the mobile viewport and is additionally covered by the persistent app layout. Mitigation: make sheet content scrollable and account for keyboard/safe area.
